column1: # Marker -> UniProt overrides for this benchmark's 18-marker cHL CODEX panel.
# Layered on top of VirTues-Nextflow's assets/marker_uniprot.csv
# by load_marker_table(). Only the rows that file cannot resolve are here.
# VirTues identifies a channel ONLY by an ESM-2 embedding of its target's amino
# acid sequence — there is no marker-name vocabulary in the model
# and no name-matching fallback. A channel with no accession is not seen at all.
# Matching is separator- and case-insensitive
# shipped `CD11b` row; the three rows below are the ones CORAL's canonical
# spelling misses.
# 17 of the 18 panel markers resolve. See CLAUDE.md for the harmonisation table.
marker
# CORAL canonicalises pan-cytokeratin to `cytokeratin`; the shipped table keys
# the same antibody as `panCK`. Same accession
# binds many keratins and spora's table picks KRT14 for all of them.
cytokeratin
# `mct` is this panel's name for mast cell tryptase; the shipped table keys it as
# `Tryptase`. TPSAB1 is alpha/beta-1 tryptase
mct
